steps.content: You watch as the sneering desert bandit takes out a blood-red, teardrop-shaped crystal and places it into a strange device.
Instantly, a massive spurt of suffocating energy shoots out from the device, enveloping the area.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the thing in his hand appears to be... an Ash Crystal!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Good! We can see what this Ash Crystal can do! Ahhh!!
The hull of the V-710 suddenly shakes violently, flinging you all to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The sand is rolling! Chief... there is something underground.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: It's the sandworms! They are moving underground, and heading toward us!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Why? Didn't we steer clear of them just now?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It seems... that the desert bandits are controlling the sandworms with the Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Controlling sandworms? I've never heard of anyone who can control sandworms.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Oh? So you actually guessed what this is used for? That's fine... soon, I'll go back to being the only one in the world who knows! Hahahaha! Come, my monsters, come play with these brats!
Boom! Many giant sandworms swarm out from underground and surge towards you...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ptui! Ptui! Ahhhhh!
Hella wipes the mucus off her face with disgust, her mouth puckered way up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: These disgusting sandworms are everywhere! We can't drive them away fast enough!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We cannot break through the encirclement. Chief, it's a trap. We're stuck.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh! These desert bandits are just as despicable as the sandworms! Come fight me one on one if you have the gall!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Hehe, your Syndican cursing won't help you now, wench! Too bad... I won't respond to your provocations.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: Boss, you're truly the ****! You knew right away that something was off about this ship.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: We must've made the DisCity bigwigs lose their minds from anger! They're now even resorting to dirty tactics like disguising a battleship as a Hypercube freighter! They even hired Syndican thugs, too!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Hmph, DisCity has been living large from the Hypercubes for too long. It's time for them to face the truth... Without their precious Hypercubes, they are nothing!
Upon hearing their boss's riveting declaration, the desert bandits cackle wildly. Some even hoist up their victory flag.
You know the desert bandits are trying to provoke you to deplete the V-710's reserves so that you become completely defenseless.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Power and navigation systems normal; Hypercube force field status: activated; ammunition reserves: 90%.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If it weren't for these sandworms, we'd have enough ammunition to blast those desert bandits many times over! Damn it!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, Kawa-kawa! You know WhiteSands better than any of us! Is there any way we can lose those disgusting sandworms and directly fight the bandits?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Actually, there is a way... but even if we can get past the controlled sandworms, the biggest problem now is that we've been held up for too long! "It" is coming!
You all follow Kawa-kawa's gaze into the distance.
Across the vast and boundless WhiteSands, the roaring gale has whipped up sand waves ten thousand feet high. As the sandstorm pounces towards you, the gray behemoth behind it comes into view.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is that... The Tide of Ashes?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So they want to use the Tide of Ashes to kill us??
Yes, that's the desert bandits' plan... They want to eliminate a "bigwig" from DisCity to showcase their power.
They want DisCity to not only overlook their previous Hypercube heists, but to share Hypercube resources with DisCity from now on.
The buzzing in your ears grows ever more shrill as the Tide of Ashes prepares to overwhelm you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Ac... activate the Hypercube force field! At least try to avoid the incoming—
It's too late! With a few roaring shots, the desert bandits' cannons strike the V-710's anti-Apocalypse equipment.
The Hypercube force field disappears in an instance. The Tide of Ashes surges forward and swallows everything!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Oh arrogant DisCitizens, have a taste of the wrath we have felt towards you for so long! You who monopolize all the resources and look down upon us Outlanders...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Experience your ignorance and faults in endless pain! Soon, death shall be your only relief! Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: Boss, there's a new target. The scouting team has identified a Hypercube freighter.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Great! Take the Ash Crystal. We need it to escape the Tide of Ashes. All attention and head out!

The roaring wind sweeps up countless white sand, relentlessly pummeling everything around you. You half-kneel on the deck, grasping the railing without the ability to move. You can only watch as the desert bandits disappear into the distance.
${PlayerName}, come over here!
You look towards the direction of the voice and see a slender beacon emitting warm yellow light, projecting a hemispherical shield.
At the center of the shield is Kawa-kawa, who is extending his hand and anxiously calling out to you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief, come to the beacon!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: This is only the edge of the Tide of Ashes. My shield can still withstand it.
Shield...?
You have no time to ponder about it right now. You must bring Hella and Hecate to Kawa-kawa.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can't! The wind is too strong, I can't reach you... help me!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, use the shackles! Strengthen the Nightmare... let it... take us...

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Use the shackles
The enhanced Nightmare drags you towards Kawa-kawa inch by inch.
But just as you are about to reach the shield, a swarm of sandworms surge out from the ground. You instinctively push Hella and Hecate into the shield.

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content: Chief!!!
